description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Special Allowance payable to the Mayor, Deputy Mayor and a member of the Dambulla Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette content establishes regulations for special allowances payable to municipal council officials (Mayor, Deputy Mayor, Members) for committee participation. It is a regulatory matter created under the authority of the Municipal Councils Ordinance and Provincial Council Act, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) as it creates binding rules and regulations rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
